issues.title: User data interpolated into a SQL string
issues.whats_wrong: f-string builds SELECT * FROM reports WHERE batch = '{data}'. This is a SQL-injection pattern.
how_to_fix: Delete the unused query or use a parameterized query.

issues.title: Function and locals violate PEP 8 naming
issues.whats_wrong: BuildReport is camelCase/PascalCase. Locals data, tmp, x, i are cryptic.
issues.why_it_matters: Readers cannot tell what each variable holds.
how_to_fix: Rename to build_report and use domain names.

issues.title: Noisy comments restating the next line
issues.whats_wrong: Comments restate set default list, increment counter, append row.
acceptance_criteria: No comments that only narrate the next line.

issues.title: One function mixes mapping, mutation, and JSON
issues.whats_wrong: A single function mixes several concerns: mapping, comps, VAT, and serialization.
issues.why_it_matters: Hard to change one concern without touching others.
acceptance_criteria: VAT/comp live in a named helper.
